factions.name: Ashgrove Network
factions.agency: Regional coordination network linking owners, merchants, officials, transport operators, and patrol representatives.

factions.name: Enslaved Communities
factions.agency: Distinct communities with expertise, relationships, goals, disagreements, and resistance strategies.

factions.name: Free Black Communities
factions.agency: Churches, families, artisans, boatmen, healers, and organizers providing shelter, information, and judgement.

factions.name: Escape Network
factions.agency: Decentralized routes, refuges, conductors, healers, printers, and community decisions.

factions.name: Plantation Authorities
factions.agency: Owners, overseers, managers, and specialists controlling land, labour, food, tools, and records.

factions.name: Patrols and Militias
factions.agency: Slave patrols, militias, bounty hunters, informants, and local officials; not the post-1865 Ku Klux Klan.

factions.name: Merchants and Transport Interests
factions.agency: River, port, warehouse, credit, insurance, and transport interests converting coercion into financial value.

factions.name: Abolitionist Network
factions.agency: Printers, correspondents, religious communities, organizers, and allies with distinct politics and risks.
